FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 187
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representatives Alan Baker
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/30/2026
House Bill 187 as introduced would increase the obligations of the governing bodies of local
boards of education and public charter schools by an undetermined amount dependent on the
cost to purchase mobile emergency rapid response systems and equip and train designated
personnel by October 1, 2030, subject to annual dedicated school safety funds. This bill would
allow the governing bodies to use certain state funds to comply with the provisions of this bill.
Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board of
Education to develop a list of approved vendors providing mobile approved emergency rapid
response systems.
